tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Save a durable fact from this conversation to project memory — a key decision, a user preference, or an important detail worth remembering across sessions. title must be a very short one-line summary (<=80 chars); content is the full detail. Saving the same title again overwrites it.

title.description: very short one-line summary of the memory

tools.name: load_memory
tools.description: Read one stored memory's full content by its exact title.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Search stored project memories by title or content; returns matching titles with snippets. Call with a topic to recall relevant long-term facts; an empty query lists the most recent memories.

query.description: topic to search for; empty lists recent
